image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of two stacked audio cassette tapes. The top cassette has a white label with hand-drawn or printed graphics (a blue figure on the left, a character on the right) and a black strip at the bottom with white text that appears to be gibberish or stylized non-Latin script. The bottom cassette is partially visible, showing a beige/cream casing with a transparent window revealing brown magnetic tape and gold-colored spool hubs. The background includes a wooden surface and a blurry metallic object at the top.
